propositions: Reconciler read/check paths currently call load_config() and inspect ambient environment/cwd, allowing settings to reload during operation and change read scope
Jira backends are constructed with properties that can reload from ambient settings rather than using immutable bindings from the S1 snapshot
Read/check operations must be refactored to use focused immutable ReconcilerSettings, GitRuntime, and BridgeRuntime projections with exactly one selected provider backend
Backend project scope, query, TLS, timeout, limits, tracker layout, and auth must remain stable throughout the operation and not be affected by environment mutations
Secrets in static fields must use non-serializable Pydantic types and be excluded from repr/equality/hash/cache/fingerprint, unwrapping only in the selected Jira sending adapter
